optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Operations Process Specialist, Equipment Maintenance Services

professionalSummary.text: Operational specialist with 18 months of experience in maintenance services division, owning work-order intake, scheduling, and parts coordination for two regional service teams.
professionalSummary.witness: Responsibilities included work-order intake, scheduling, parts-request checklist maintenance and depot coordination for about eighteen months in the maintenance services division.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran work-order intake and scheduling for two regional service teams, assigning planned maintenance and breakdown jobs to technicians and re-sequencing schedules when breakdowns occurred.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran work-order intake and scheduling for two regional service teams in the field-service system, assigning planned maintenance and breakdown jobs to technicians and re-sequencing the day when a breakdown came in.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained the parts-request checklist used by dispatchers, adding a step to confirm depot stock for top twenty part numbers before visit confirmation.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the parts-request checklist that dispatchers complete before a visit is confirmed, adding a step to confirm depot stock for the top twenty part numbers.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated parts availability with three regional depots daily via phone and stock reports, with stock transfers approved by depot supervisors.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated parts availability with the three regional depots by phone and the depot stock report each morning; stock transfers between depots were approved by the depot supervisors.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented weekly scheduling hand-overs for incoming dispatchers, listing open work orders, parts on order, and jobs requiring second visits.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the weekly scheduling hand-over for the incoming dispatcher, listing open work orders, parts still on order and jobs that needed a second visit.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Developed and maintained a parts-request checklist with depot-stock verification step, reducing repeat visits by an estimated 33% as reported by dispatch supervisor.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Maintained the parts-request checklist that dispatchers complete before a visit is confirmed, adding a step to confirm depot stock for the top twenty part numbers. Reference call with former dispatch supervisor: said the checklist change 'made a real difference' and that repeat visits 'went down a lot, maybe by a third'; she could not recall whether anyone had measured it and said the division did not track repeat-visit reasons at the time.

skills.text: Work-order management, parts coordination, scheduling, and documentation in field-service systems.
skills.witness: Responsibilities included work-order intake, scheduling, parts-request checklist maintenance and depot coordination for about eighteen months in the maintenance services division.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's responsibilities and actions related to work-order intake, scheduling, parts checklist maintenance, depot coordination, and weekly hand-overs. They partially support the claim of reducing repeat visits by an estimated 33%, but do not establish a measured baseline or period for this reduction.
